leads: The surviving first paragraph explicitly proposes a homotopy exact sequence for relative fundamental group schemes as a conjecture. A longer parenthesis about independence from a section and the complete-local case is cancelled; do not promote the cancellation to a surviving claim.

Conditional consequences stated here include a product formula for complete schemes and, for an abelian variety, commutativity, minimal principal covers being isogenies, and Π₁(X/k)=lim_n nX including infinitesimal torsion.

Cartier duality is invoked to identify the dual as the ind-group of torsion in the dual abelian variety. The p-component is expected to replace the Weil module; the proposed Witt-module functor and three-part decomposition are called “hors de doute” and “facile de vérifier”, without a proof here.
The phrase “Utilisant tes raisonnements” signals correspondence with an unnamed addressee; attribution and date are not supplied on this sheet.
